# DJI Live Bridge

> A free, open-source desktop app (macOS and Windows) that receives the RTMP stream DJI Fly sends
> from a DJI drone and restreams it to Instagram, TikTok and any other RTMP destination at the same
> time, or exposes it as a virtual camera named "DJI Live Bridge Camera" for TikTok LIVE Studio,
> OBS and Zoom.

Everything runs locally: the drone video never passes through a third-party server. FFmpeg and the
media server are bundled, so nothing else has to be installed. Stream keys are kept in the operating
system's credential vault. Version 0.2.6. MIT licence; the bundled FFmpeg is LGPL, built
without GPL components.

Key facts:
- Platforms: macOS 13 or newer (Apple Silicon and Intel, signed and notarized), Windows 10/11 (beta, unsigned installer).
- Android: a separate paid app, "Stream My Drone" (Android 9 or newer, one-time purchase on Google Play), receives the DJI Fly stream on the phone and forwards it unchanged to several RTMP/RTMPS destinations; no virtual camera, no portrait conversion.
- Output: 1080x1920 portrait, 30 fps, 6 Mbps CBR, H.264 High, 2-second keyframes; empty space filled with a blurred copy of the picture.
- Input: whatever DJI Fly sends over RTMP, often 720p from the controller.
- Also receives DJI Osmo cameras (Osmo Action, Osmo Pocket, Osmo 360) that stream RTMP from the DJI Mimo app.
- The virtual camera carries video only, so TikTok LIVE Studio keeps control of audio.
- Not affiliated with DJI, Instagram, TikTok or Apple.

## Documentation
- [Home page](https://tanerozel.github.io/dji-live-bridge/): what the app does, how to set it up, FAQ.
- [Full site text](https://tanerozel.github.io/dji-live-bridge/llms-full.txt): every section of the home page and every guide as plain text.
- [Blog](https://tanerozel.github.io/dji-live-bridge/blog/): step-by-step guides for each streaming platform, in English and Turkish.
- [README](https://github.com/tanerozel/dji-live-bridge/blob/main/README.md): installation, streaming guide, development notes.
- [Turkish README](https://github.com/tanerozel/dji-live-bridge/blob/main/README.tr.md): the same document in Turkish; 13 further languages sit beside it.
- [Releases](https://github.com/tanerozel/dji-live-bridge/releases/latest): downloads for macOS and Windows.
- [Stream My Drone on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.streammydrone.app): the Android app.
- [Dependencies](https://tanerozel.github.io/dji-live-bridge/DEPENDENCIES.md): third-party components and their licences.
- [Security policy](https://tanerozel.github.io/dji-live-bridge/SECURITY.md): how to report a vulnerability.

## Guides
- [Spot and count animals live from your DJI drone](https://tanerozel.github.io/dji-live-bridge/blog/count-animals-with-a-dji-drone-ai-detection/): DJI Live Bridge spots goats, sheep, cows, horses, donkeys and poultry in your drone's live picture, marks them on the stream and counts them, all on your own computer.
- [DJI Fly RTMP live streaming: the complete setup](https://tanerozel.github.io/dji-live-bridge/blog/dji-fly-rtmp-live-streaming-setup/): How to set up RTMP live streaming in DJI Fly: where the setting is, which address to enter, how to network the controller and computer, and how to fix it.
- [Why DJI Fly can't live stream to Instagram (and the fix)](https://tanerozel.github.io/dji-live-bridge/blog/why-dji-fly-cannot-stream-to-instagram/): DJI Fly has no Instagram option and its RTMP client cannot do the encrypted RTMPS Instagram requires. Here is why, and how to go live on Instagram from a DJI drone anyway.
- [Turn your DJI drone into your computer's webcam](https://tanerozel.github.io/dji-live-bridge/blog/use-your-dji-drone-as-a-webcam/): Turn your DJI drone into a webcam for TikTok LIVE Studio, OBS, Zoom, Google Meet or Teams with the DJI Live Bridge virtual camera. Setup, ideas and fixes.
- [How to live stream a DJI Mini 4 Pro](https://tanerozel.github.io/dji-live-bridge/blog/dji-mini-4-pro-live-stream/): How to live stream a DJI Mini 4 Pro with the DJI RC 2 or RC-N2: RTMP in DJI Fly, the microphone rule, 720p limits and going live on Instagram, TikTok and YouTube.
- [How to live stream a DJI Neo](https://tanerozel.github.io/dji-live-bridge/blog/dji-neo-live-stream/): How to live stream a DJI Neo: which control mode works (phone, RC-N3, goggles), RTMP in DJI Fly, and going live on Instagram, TikTok or YouTube with DJI Live Bridge.
- [How to live stream a DJI Avata 2](https://tanerozel.github.io/dji-live-bridge/blog/dji-avata-2-live-stream/): How to live stream FPV footage from a DJI Avata 2: share the Goggles 3 view to DJI Fly on your phone, stream over RTMP and go live on Instagram, TikTok or YouTube.
- [Live stream your DJI Osmo camera to Instagram, TikTok and more](https://tanerozel.github.io/dji-live-bridge/blog/dji-osmo-live-stream-instagram-tiktok/): DJI Mimo can stream Osmo Action, Osmo Pocket and Osmo 360 cameras over RTMP. Send that to DJI Live Bridge to go live on Instagram, TikTok and YouTube at once.
- [How to live stream an Osmo Pocket 3 to Instagram and TikTok](https://tanerozel.github.io/dji-live-bridge/blog/osmo-pocket-3-live-stream/): How to live stream a DJI Osmo Pocket 3 over RTMP from DJI Mimo to Instagram, TikTok and YouTube at once, and use it as a wireless webcam, with DJI Live Bridge.
- [How to live stream an Osmo Action camera to Instagram and TikTok](https://tanerozel.github.io/dji-live-bridge/blog/osmo-action-live-stream/): Live stream a DJI Osmo Action 6, 5 Pro, 4 or 3 over RTMP from DJI Mimo to Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and Twitch at once with DJI Live Bridge. Setup and settings.
- [How to go live on TikTok with a DJI drone](https://tanerozel.github.io/dji-live-bridge/blog/how-to-go-live-on-tiktok-with-a-dji-drone/): Stream a DJI drone live on TikTok from DJI Fly: with a TikTok stream key, or without one through TikTok LIVE Studio and a virtual camera. Settings and fixes.
- [How to go live on Instagram with a DJI drone](https://tanerozel.github.io/dji-live-bridge/blog/how-to-go-live-on-instagram-with-a-dji-drone/): Go live on Instagram from a DJI drone: get the stream URL and key on instagram.com, send DJI Fly's RTMP stream through DJI Live Bridge, then press Go live.
- [How to live stream a DJI drone to YouTube](https://tanerozel.github.io/dji-live-bridge/blog/how-to-live-stream-a-dji-drone-to-youtube/): Stream a DJI drone live to YouTube: enable live streaming, copy the stream key from YouTube Studio, send DJI Fly's RTMP through DJI Live Bridge. Settings and tips.
- [How to go live on Facebook with a DJI drone](https://tanerozel.github.io/dji-live-bridge/blog/how-to-go-live-on-facebook-with-a-dji-drone/): Stream a DJI drone live on Facebook: get the RTMPS server URL and stream key from Live Producer, send DJI Fly's stream through DJI Live Bridge, and go live.
- [How to stream a DJI drone on Twitch](https://tanerozel.github.io/dji-live-bridge/blog/how-to-stream-a-dji-drone-on-twitch/): Stream a DJI drone live on Twitch: copy your stream key from the Creator Dashboard, add Twitch as a custom RTMP destination in DJI Live Bridge and go live.
- [How to stream a DJI drone on Kick](https://tanerozel.github.io/dji-live-bridge/blog/how-to-stream-a-dji-drone-on-kick/): Stream a DJI drone live on Kick: copy the stream URL and key from the Kick dashboard, add them as a custom RTMP destination in DJI Live Bridge, and go live.
- [Stream a DJI drone to several platforms at once](https://tanerozel.github.io/dji-live-bridge/blog/stream-a-dji-drone-to-multiple-platforms-at-once/): Send one DJI drone live stream to TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, Twitch and Kick at the same time with DJI Live Bridge — free, local, no restream service.
- [DJI Live Bridge vs Restream: which one for your drone?](https://tanerozel.github.io/dji-live-bridge/blog/dji-live-bridge-vs-restream/): Streaming a DJI drone to several platforms: Restream's cloud relay or DJI Live Bridge on your own computer? Cost, watermark, Instagram, vertical video and when each one wins.
- [Stream a DJI drone without setting up NGINX and OBS](https://tanerozel.github.io/dji-live-bridge/blog/dji-drone-to-obs-without-nginx/): The usual way to get DJI Fly into OBS is an NGINX RTMP server, a config file and a media source. Here is what that setup involves, and the one-app way to skip it.
